title: Narrow AI and General AI
introduction: AI systems can be discussed by the breadth of tasks they are able to perform.
learningOutcomes: Define artificial narrow intelligence and artificial general intelligence.
Compare specialised capability with general capability.

activities.question: A highly capable chess program is an example of narrow AI.
activities.explanation: Its capability is specialised for chess, even if it performs that task better than most people.

activities.question: Which statement about artificial general intelligence is most accurate?
options: It is a hypothetical form of AI with broad, adaptable intellectual capability
It is another name for every current chatbot
It means software installed in several countries
It is any system that performs one task very well
activities.explanation: AGI describes a proposed broad and adaptable capability; there is no settled demonstration that current systems meet it.
